verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is a cloud platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows SDKs, a CLI, llms.txt and markdown docs, but no first-party MCP server. The only MCP-related item is a community developer's own MCP-JS runtime that controls sandboxes over gRPC, which is a third-party workaround and not an official server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
